mapper.insert: INSERT into book_subject ( name,full_name,code,book_id,subject_model_id,type_id,category_id,balance_direction,balance_direction_text,balance_init_date,`level`,create_time,update_time,balance_init_checked,credit_checked,debit_checked,is_leaf ) SELECT mo.name,mo.full_name,mo.code,#{bookId},mo.model_id,mo.type_id,mo.category_id,mo.balance_direction,mo.balance_direction_text,NOW(),mo.`level`,NOW(),NOW(),mo.balance_init_checked,mo.credit_checked,mo.debit_checked,mo.is_leaf from book_subject_model mo where mo.account_template_id = #{templateId}
mapper.select: select account_template_id from t_account_book where book_id = #{bookId}
select bs.*,concat(bs.code,' ',bs.full_name) subjectNameBy from book_subject bs where book_id = #{bookId} and is_leaf = 1 ORDER BY `code`
select bs.*,concat(bs.code,' ',bs.full_name) subjectNameBy from book_subject bs where book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY `code`
SELECT * FROM `book_subject` where book_id = #{bookId} and name = '本年利润';

SELECT '期初余额（综合本位币）' node1,'累计发生额（综合本位币）' node2, a.*,(a.debitTotal1-a.creditTotal1) imbalance1,(a.debitTotal2-a.creditTotal2)imbalance2 from ( SELECT (SELECT SUM(balance_init) from book_subject where book_id = #{bookId} and balance_direction = 'DEBIT' and level = 1) debitTotal1, (SELECT SUM(balance_init) from book_subject where book_id = #{bookId} and balance_direction = 'CREDIT' and level = 1) creditTotal1, (SELECT SUM(credit) from book_subject where book_id = #{bookId} and level = 1) creditTotal2, (SELECT SUM(debit) from book_subject where book_id = #{bookId} and level = 1) debitTotal2 )a
